title: Holi Day Checklist: What to Wear and Carry for a Stress-Free Day
excerpt: A practical Holi checklist of what to wear and carry: outfit, layers, footwear, bag essentials and the small items that make the day easier.
body:
For a stress-free Holi, wear a comfortable cotton outfit you do not mind getting coloured, closed shoes with grip and a small zipped bag, and carry a spare set of clothes, a towel and a bag for wet things. That is the short answer. Below is the full checklist for 22 March 2027, so you can pack once and simply enjoy the day.

## What to wear

### The outfit

Start with an outfit that moves with you and washes easily.

- **Cotton kurta set or tunic with jeans.** Cotton is comfortable and simple to wash.
- **Relaxed fit.** Wet fabric feels tighter, so give yourself a little room.
- **A colour you love.** White is classic, while pastels and prints hide marks better afterwards.

A [sky blue hand block print tunic](/products/sky-blue-hand-block-print-cotton-tunic-top/) with jeans is an easy pick for outdoor play.

For a gathering where you want a full set, the [sage teal block print kurta palazzo set](/products/sage-teal-block-print-cotton-kurta-palazzo-set/) is comfortable and photogenic.

See more relaxed separates in our [tunic tops](/cotton-tunic-tops-short-kurtis-for-jeans/) collection.

### Layers and underlayers

- **A good underlayer.** A white or nude slip, camisole or vest keeps a light kurta from turning see-through when wet.
- **Leggings or shorts** under palazzos or skirts for easy movement.
- **A warm layer** if you are celebrating somewhere cool: a denim jacket, old hoodie or shawl.
- **Socks** you are happy to throw away later.

### Footwear

Footwear is where many people go wrong. Choose:

- **Closed trainers or sturdy sandals with grip.** Wet floors, grass and coloured water are slippery.
- **Old shoes.** Colour can stain canvas and leather.
- **Avoid** heels, suede, open slides and anything precious.

## What to carry: the bag essentials

Keep everything in a small crossbody bag with a zip, worn in front so you can keep an eye on it.

| Item | Why you need it |
|---|---|
| Phone in a resealable pouch | Keeps it dry and colour-free |
| Small amount of cash and one card | Easy to carry, less to lose |
| Spare top or full change of clothes | To travel home comfortably |
| Small towel | For drying off hands and hair |
| Plastic or carrier bag | For wet, coloured clothes |
| Wet wipes and tissues | Quick clean-ups |
| Hair ties and a comb | To tidy up afterwards |
| Old sunglasses | Keep your good pair at home |
| Water bottle | Long days outdoors |
| Packet of dry gulal | To join in the fun |

## Before you leave home

- **Leave fine jewellery behind.** Gold, diamonds and watches can get lost in crowds.
- **Tie your hair up.** A braid or a low bun keeps it tidy.
- **Put on old underwear and socks.** Colour travels everywhere.
- **Plan your journey home.** If you are taking a train, bus or taxi, pack a change of clothes and a seat cover or old towel for the car.
- **Charge your phone.** You will want photos.

## The after-party switch

Many people change into something fresh for a Holi lunch or evening get-together. Pack a light second outfit that does not crease easily. A cotton co-ord set is ideal. The [white and blue floral halter peplum top with palazzo](/products/white-blue-floral-cotton-halter-peplum-top-with-palazzo-co-ord-set/) folds small and looks put-together straight out of the bag.

A bright [yellow embroidered tunic with black floral yoke](/products/yellow-black-embroidered-cotton-tunic-top/) with jeans is another easy swap.

## Frequently asked questions

**What should I carry in my bag on Holi?**
Your phone in a waterproof pouch, a little cash, a spare set of clothes, a small towel, wet wipes, hair ties and a bag for wet clothes.

**What footwear is best for Holi?**
Old closed trainers or sturdy sandals with good grip. Avoid heels, suede and anything you want to keep spotless.

**Should I wear jewellery on Holi?**
Keep it minimal. Leave gold and precious pieces at home and choose simple oxidised or fashion jewellery instead.

**What should I wear after playing Holi?**
A light, crease-friendly outfit like a cotton co-ord set or a tunic with jeans, so you feel fresh for lunch or the evening.
